brief.status: Fictional client; synthetic scenario facts and approvals
brief.objective: Turn relevant paid traffic into first orders, recover eligible checkouts and encourage a second purchase.
products: House Blend: 12 oz, $18, 100% arabica, medium roast, whole bean, cocoa and toasted-nut tasting notes
House Blend Duo: two 12 oz bags, $34, one-time purchase
brief.offer: WELCOME10: 10% off an eligible first US order. Valid October 1–November 1, 2026. Once per customer; no stacking; excludes shipping, tax and gift cards.
brief.retention_offer: RESTOCK10: 10% off eligible product subtotal of at least $30. Exactly one prior order fulfilled at least 28 days ago, with no later order. Valid October 19–November 1, 2026. Once per customer; no stacking.
brief.shipping: Contiguous US only. $5.95 shipping; free only when product subtotal after discounts is at least $50.
brief.destination_status: Reserved .example simulation destination; structurally checked, no live HTTP validation.
brief.audience_ownership: Mailchimp owns consented zero-order prospects without an active checkout. Klaviyo owns checkout and customer lifecycle. Purchase exits prospect messages; checkout takes priority; global suppression and revoked consent override all sends.
brief.native_limit: Native Google Ads and Mailchimp reads check available accounts/audiences only. A verified same-client mapping is still required for performance queries. No native draft is created.

mailchimp_drafts.preheader: Whole-bean coffee for your daily brew.
mailchimp_drafts.body: Meet House Blend: medium-roast whole beans with cocoa and toasted-nut tasting notes. Explore the 12 oz bag for $18 before discount. As an eligible first-time US customer, save 10% with WELCOME10. Find your next morning coffee.
mailchimp_drafts.eligibility: Permissioned contiguous-US subscribers with zero lifetime orders and an email click within 60 days. Exclude purchasers, active checkout within 7 days, complaints, bounces, global suppression and recent competing promotions. Refresh eligibility before implementation.
mailchimp_drafts.suppression: Klaviyo owns checkout and post-purchase cohorts. Exit this campaign on checkout or purchase; unknown/revoked consent overrides all eligibility. Verify cross-platform synchronization, sender/footer and unsubscribe/preferences links. Review existing invitation and brewing-guide schedules; proposed 72-hour promotional cap.

brief.native_proposals_note: These are unsaved proposals from the synthetic client brief. Native discovery responses are shown separately. Verify the same-client account/audience, products/offers, conversion definition, tracking, consent, copy and test design before building inside the platform.

meta.attribution: 7-day click / 1-day view, interaction week. Platform purchase credits and revenue stay separate from all other platforms.

findings.finding: Static purchase CPA rose from $50 to $91.67; row-level frequency rose from 2 to 4. This supports a creative test, without proving fatigue.
Morning brew video: $400 / 13 purchase credits = $30.77 CPA. The observed comparison is not a randomized result.

test.action: Randomized 50/50 M1 vs M2 creative test; Sales/Purchase; identical offer, audience, landing page and bidding. Proposed five-day $500 ceiling from existing allocation, pending budget approval.
test.audience: Consented-match exclusions where available: known purchasers, active checkouts within 7 days, global suppression and Mailchimp test recipients. Contiguous-US adults; verify match coverage.
test.learning: Whether creative concept improves purchase efficiency on the same prospecting audience.
test.approval: Account selection, approved assets and rights, copy, audience/exclusions, placement fit, purchase definition, budget source, test duration/sample and stop rules. No deployment approved.

klaviyo.attribution: 5-day click / 1-day open, send week. Orders and revenue are Klaviyo-attributed and must not be added to Meta or Mailchimp credits.

findings.finding: Checkout orders/delivered fell from 30/410 (7.317%) to 24/420 (5.714%). This is a message-level rate, not a checkout-cohort conversion rate.
Replenishment has zero sends and remains a draft. No historical lift or conversion rate exists.
